name: Wing Bunker
tagline: IN THE GAS STATION. FRIED TO ORDER.
address: Inside the Vandergrift Fuel Stop, 11840 South Frontage Road at Exit 41B, Use The Door By The Air Pump, Wexler Township
about: We are the wing counter at the back of the gas station. My father ran the fryer at the Route 9 location from 1996 until it closed in 2011 and this is the same fryer, we moved it ourselves. Everything is fried to order which is why it takes as long as it takes. The pumps are not us.
announcement: YES WE ARE INSIDE THE GAS STATION. Kitchen is in the back past the coffee, keep walking. We do not sell the gas and we cannot fix the pump receipt printer, that is corporate. Wings are fried to order, 18 to 20 minutes, the app time is not our time. Drivers: use the side door by the air pump, the main door alarm goes off after 8. If you cant find it call (330) 555-0164 and I will come out. Thank you. - Ray

reviews.name: Dennis K.
reviews.text: I have been getting wings here every Friday for four years and I have brought my brother, my crew, my ex-wife's new husband and a guy I met at the tire place. It is a gas station. I understand that this bothers people. The wings are better than any sit-down wing place within thirty miles and Ray sorts the flats by hand if you pay the flats charge, which I do, every week, and I have never once regretted it. Order the 20 and get the Bunker tier and do not eat one standing up.

reviews.name: Marisol A.
reviews.text: Fried to order means fried to order, so stop leaving one stars because it took twenty minutes. The blue cheese is made in house on Tuesdays and you can taste that it is.

reviews.name: Wayne T.
reviews.text: The receipt printer on pump 4 has been out of paper since June and the man behind the counter told me he does not work for the gas station. Then who does. I did not order food.

reviews.name: Brianna S.
reviews.text: Docked one star because I was charged $1.15 to decline the dip cup and the note said the cups are ordered by the sleeve either way. Which is fair. The wings were excellent.

reviews.name: Reggie D.
reviews.text: Got The Whole Thing for my kid's graduation. Lid does not stay on, he tells you that on the app, and he is right. Fed nineteen people and the fire department stopped by for the rest.

reviews.name: Otis P.
reviews.text: Called three times about a catering order and a woman kept picking up and saying this is the deli. This is the second wing place I have had this problem with.

menu.name: Wings By The Count

items.name: 10 Wings

Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out hotspot on the sauce, hard black shadow thrown behind the clamshell, flat fluorescent room light behind it. Framed slightly crooked and shot from too close, the clamshell cut off at the right edge, sitting on a plain scratched laminate counter next to a stack of napkins. Plain blank background: bare counter and an out-of-focus stainless surface only, no signs, no posters, no menu boards, no printed packaging anywhere in the frame. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible sensor noise. Square crop, no border, no frame, no filter effect. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Tier 4 — Bunker

options.note: Accurate. Charged the same as inaccurate.

options.name: Honey Mustard, One Cup

menu.name: The Whole Thing
menu.blurb: A customer named this in 2014 and we never changed it. Call ahead for anything on this page.

items.name: The Whole Thing
items.desc: One hundred wings in a bucket. The lid does not stay on. We are telling you now so you are not surprised at the counter.

Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Shot from too close and slightly above so the bucket is not centred, cluttered background of a stainless prep counter with a stack of lids, a napkin dispenser and another order waiting in a foil tray. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, visible JPEG compression and sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Bucket Taped Shut

Sauced In Four Separate Pans

Tier 4 — Bunker, One Hundred Wings

options.name: The Bus Tub

options.note: Correct order. Fries arrive hot.

options.name: Fries Before The Wings
options.note: Wrong order. We will do it.

options.name: Both At Once, Two Baskets
options.note: The oil drops forty degrees and everything after you waits.

options.name: No Preference On Order
options.note: Then it goes wings first, and this is what deciding costs.

options.name: Salt Packets On The Side
options.note: From the rack by the coffee. Not ours, technically.

items.name: Bunker Party Pack
items.desc: Forty wings, two trays of fries and a tray of fried pickles. This is the one we do for graduations and shift changes at the plant.

groups.name: Head Count Ray Is Cooking For

options.name: Municipal

options.name: Regional
options.note: Requires the second fryer, which he will turn on for you.

options.name: As Soon As It Is Ready
Hold It In The Hot Case

options.name: Scheduled For A Specific Time
options.note: Written on the wall calendar in pencil.

options.name: No Window, I Will Show Up
options.note: The uncertainty is the charge.

options.name: The Dispenser Itself

menu.name: Out Of The Fryer

options.name: No Liner
